Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ATCs of 20 KVA DG Sets (1) The instant bid is governed by GeM GTC, ATCs, Buyer added text based ATCs, GFR-2017, Manual for procurement of Goods-2024 (Second Edition) and subsequent guidelines / orders circulated by Govt. of India from time to time. (2) Participating firm should not be Blacklisted, Suspended or Debarred by any Government departm ent. If this is found to be false at any stage, Sashastra Seema Bal (MHA) shall have the right to reject su ch bid; if the bid has resulted in a contract, the contract will be liable for termination without prejudice t o any other right or remedy available to this organization. (3) QRs/Specifications are sacrosanct. No query/representation for change in QRs/Specification shall be entertained. (4) Conflict of Interest: The firm shall submit the declaration as per Appendix-“E” along with the bid documents failing which their bid shall be rejected.

(5) Making of cartels and collusive bidding is restricted under the Competition Act, 2002. The firms ar e required to submit an affidavit/ self certificate in this regard as per Appendix-H. (6) Firm /Seller has to submit Appendix – “A to I” and other necessary Documents / Certificates / A cceptance / Undertaking along with the bid. (7) Bn, Coy & BOP wise consignee locations are mentioned in Appendix – “J” (8) Pre-Bid Conference:- Bidders are requested to attend a Pre-bid conference for clarification on the Bid’s technical specification s and commercial conditions on 23/10/2026 at 1100 hrs at Provisioning Directorate, Force HQrs, SSB, E ast Block-V, Sector-1, R.K. Puram, New Delhi-110066. Bidders may also submit written queries through the representation window made available by GeM on GeM portal. The queries from bidders will be allowed only till 22/10/2026, thereafter, no query will be entertain ed. If required, corrigendum shall be issued, containing amendments of various provisions of the bid, which shall form part of the bid. (9) Experience Criteria:- Experience Criteria mentioned at Clause-6 & 11 of Page No 4 & 5 of i nstant bid may be read with following additions. For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proo f:- a) Purchase Order copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that supplies against th e invoices have been executed. b) Execution certificate by client with order value. c) Any other document in support of order execution like Third Party Inspection release Note. d) In case the bidder submits a GeM Contract for experience, then a copy of GeM Invoice/CRAC is requir ed to be submitted along with a self-certification by the bidder. (10) Past Performance: -This criterion will be exempted for Startup firms. (11) Make In India Certificate: The Firm/ Seller must submit “Make in India Certificate” from the OE M along with Bid duly mentioning “Percentage of local content” with “Details of the location (Factory / M anufacturing Plant Address) at which the local value addition is made” (Appendix-‘C’) as per Ministry of Commerce and Industry, DPIIT (Public Procurement Section) OM No. P-45021/2/2017-PP (BE-II) dated 16/09/2020 and 19/07/2024. As the bid value is more than Rs 10 Crore, the declaration relating to perce ntage of local content shall be certified by the statutory auditor or cost auditor, if the OEM is a company , and by a practicing cost accountant or a chartered accountant for OEMs other than companies, as per Clause-8 (Preference to Make In India products) of the GeM bid document. (12) Earnest Money Deposit (EMD): (i) Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) (5% of estimated cost/provisioning sanction) of Rs. 51,40,584/- ( Fifty One Lakh Forty Thousand Five hundred eighty four only) is required by non-exempted firm s and should be valid for 225 days from the date of opening of bid. (ii) EMD should be issued in favour of Second-In-Command (DDO), SBI Branch- Sector-1 (R.K. P uram), IFSC- SBIN0001076, Force Hqrs, Sashastra Seema Bal, East Block-V, Sector-1, R.K. P uram, New Delhi-110066. (iii) Original EMD (Earnest Money Deposit) should be deposited to the buyer within 05 working days of opening of bid, otherwise the bid shall be rejected during initial scrutiny.

(iv) If exemption from submission of EMD is claimed, valid supporting documents along with “Bi d Security Declaration” as per Appendix- ‘B’ must be submitted to avoid rejection. (v) EMD shall be exempted for eligible MSME and Startup OEMs and sellers holding valid vendor asses sment or Vendor Assessment exemption Report in accordance with the latest GeM General Terms and Conditions (GTC) (13) Integrity Pact: (i) Integrity Pact is to be signed between the buyer and bidder on the standard pro-forma enclosed a s Appendix-“D”. Accordingly, all bidders are required to submit 02 copies of “Integrity Pact” duly com pleted in all respects and signed properly on each page by the authorized signatories of the bidders an d two witnesses as per format, with their tender documents. (ii) Offer of those firms, who have not attached Integrity Pact, will be rejected. (14) Performance Security: (i) The final qualified Firm shall have to deposit a Performance Security Deposit of 5% of net co ntracted Value (total value of the contract) within 28 days of Award of Contract. (ii) PSD in the form of Bank Guarantee should be issued in favor of Second-In-Command (DDO), S BI Branch- Sector-1 (R.K. Puram), IFSC- SBIN0001076, Force Hqrs, Sashastra Seema Bal, Eas t Block-V, Sector-1, R.K. Puram, New Delhi-110066. (iii) The Performance Security Deposit submitted by the supplier will remain valid for 30 months. (15) Inspection: (i) Pre-Dispatch Inspection (PDI) will be carried out by a board of officers of SSB at Firm’s premis es as per approved QRs/TDs and Firm will give advance notice of 15 days through e-mail/letter. (ii) If the store is found inferior and not conforming to specifications during Pre-Dispatch Inspection (P DI), the entire consignment will be rejected at the cost and risk of the Firm. (iii) Tender store shall be dispatched by the firm only after the “PDI Report” is accepted by the buyer. (iv) Final inspection JRI will be carried out by Board of Officers (BOOs) of SSB at consignee location aft er receiving the supply of stores. (16) Terms of Delivery & Despatch Instructions: (i) Free delivery at consignee location/installation site at the risk, freight and cost of bidder. (ii) Delivery period includes time required for successful acceptance on completion of JRI/ final inspec tion at consignee location by SSB. (17) Joint Receipt Inspection (JRI):- Joint Receipt Inspection (JRI) as per QRs/TDs will be carried out by BOOs comprising of SSB technical staff and representative of the firm at consignee locations before f inal acceptance by SSB. If 20 KVA DG Set is rejected in final inspection as not conforming to Tender S pecifications, the same must be replaced within scheduled Delivery Period before final acceptance. The Consignee’s right of rejection in this regard will be final and absolute. (18) Training:- 05 days training will be conducted at Frontier level for 02 persons of each co nsignee location after successful JRI. (19) Payment Clause: Payment will be released by SSB as per GeM ICT terms (90% on delivery and 1 0% after successful Installation, Commissioning and Testing). (20) Warranty: Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 02 years (24 Months) & Warran ty of 5000 running hrs, whichever is earlier, from the date of installation and commissionin g at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by successful bidder at the tim e of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods at consignee locations in c

ase of any breakdown during the warranty period. Seller should have well established Installation, Com missioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in India for attending the after sal es service. Details of service centers near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. After having been notified of the defects / service requirement during warranty period, seller must com plete the required service / rectification within 03 days. (21) Lab test reports/Certificates: Bidders are required to submit lab test reports/certificates of the subject store as per approved QRs/TDs along with compliance statement of QRs/TDs. Lab test report sh ould not be older than 02 years from bid opening date. (22) Delivery Schedule : The Seller shall deliver 50% of the total ordered quantity at the consig nee location within 45 days from the date of award of the Contract. The remaining 50% of the order ed quantity shall be delivered within the overall delivery period of 90 days from the date of award of t he Contract. (23) PNC will be enabled in this Bid, as per the applicable provisions of the GeM terms and conditio ns and extant Government procurement guidelines. (24) Installation Teams (i) The seller shall deploy a minimum of 10 (ten) Installation Teams for Installation, Testing and Com missioning (ITC) of the Gen Sets. (ii) Each Installation Team shall consist of at least one qualified Electrician / Technician and one helpe r. Teams shall carry the necessary tools, testing equipment and consumables. (iii) Installation Teams shall be deployed Frontier-wise / Sector-wise, as per the consignee distribution list, so that ITC can be taken up simultaneously at different locations. (iv) The seller may deploy more than 10 teams to complete ITC within the stipulated period. The numb er of teams shall not be reduced below 10 till completion of ITC at all consignee locations, except with written approval of the buyer.
